SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Scientific Theory about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Scientific Theory about Human Origin.
   B. Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Scientific Theory about Human Origin as rumours only.
   D. Say Scientific Theory about Human Origin never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Trans Saharan Slave Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Trans Saharan Slave Trade as rumours only.
   B. Say Trans Saharan Slave Trade never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Trans Saharan Slave Trade.
   D. Explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ●.
   D. Say Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● never happens in Kenya.

   C. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.
   D. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

7. Which statement about Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain.
   D. Treat Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.
   C. Say Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   A. Say Self- Esteem Assessment never happens in Kenya.

14. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

15. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

16. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Kisumu

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetation in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
